title: Phase 2 Node Expansion
sourceText: We want GraphCtx Phase 2 to prove that a graph can become the interaction surface for AI work, not just an output artifact.
summary: Phase 2 should validate select-node expansion through previewable graph patches.

nodes.title: Phase 2 workflow
nodes.body: Phase 2 should prove select node, expand with context, preview patch, apply, and export.

nodes.title: How should node expansion work?
nodes.body: The selected node should drive an expansion that returns a structured graph patch.

nodes.title: Preview patches before apply
nodes.body: Graph-changing AI actions must return a previewable patch before they mutate the graph.

nodes.title: Mock mode is enough for development
nodes.body: Local deterministic mock mode can support UI development and CI.

nodes.title: Patch can corrupt graph
nodes.body: An invalid patch could leave dangling edges or hide where new context came from.

nodes.title: Validate patched export
nodes.body: Validate patch application and Context Pack export after the patch is applied.

nodes.title: Draft answer for How should node expansion work?
nodes.body: A focused next answer should address "How should node expansion work?" using the current graph context.

nodes.title: Assumption behind How should node expansion work?
nodes.body: The current graph contains enough context to propose a bounded answer without restarting from basics.

nodes.title: Validate answer for How should node expansion work?
nodes.body: Review the proposed answer against the original source notes and update the graph if it is unsupported.

edges.rationale: The workflow summary raises the expansion question.
Previewable patches answer how mutation should be handled.
Patch corruption risk supports preview and validation.
The new answer addresses the selected question.
The assumption supports the draft answer.
